sloka: तेषाम् द्रुमाणाम् प्रभया मेरोर् इव महा कपिः ।अमन्यत तदा वीरः कान्चनो अस्मि इति वानरः ॥५-१४-३९॥
transliteration: teṣām drumāṇām prabhayā meror iva mahā kapiḥ ।amanyata tadā vīraḥ kāncano asmi iti vānaraḥ ॥5-14-39॥

translations.english: He saw trees resplendent with golden radiance and thought that he was in the midst of gold like the Sungod getting golden hue by the radiance of Meru, the golden mountain.
